request.query: Who chairs the Risk Management Committee of Infosys?

response.answer:
**D. Sundaram** chairs the Risk Management Committee of Infosys.

- The Committee composition as on March 31, 2026 lists "D. Sundaram, Chairperson" among its seven independent-director members [infosys-ar-26.pdf p.108].
- The Committee's report for the year ended March 31, 2026 is signed "D. Sundaram, Chairperson" (DIN: 00016304), dated April 15, 2026 [infosys-ar-26.pdf p.109].
- The board-committee governance chart similarly shows D. Sundaram as Chairperson of the Risk Management Committee [infosys-ar-26.pdf p.98].

(Note: Michael Gibbs is Chairperson of the Cybersecurity Risk Sub-committee, which reports to the Risk Management Committee [infosys-ar-26.pdf p.110].)
